features: [64MP HIGH-RESOLUTION PHOTOS]: Capture travel memories, family moments, lifestyle shots and creator content with up to 64MP photo resolution. The Q10 is designed for users who want detailed everyday photography in a compact, easy-to-carry camera.

[4K VIDEO RECORDING FOR VLOGGING]: Create sharper and more engaging videos with 4K video recording support. Ideal for YouTube videos, travel vlogs, reels, social media content, tutorials and everyday video recording.

[180° ROTATING BODY FOR EASY SELF-VLOGGING]: The unique 180° rotating camera body makes it easier to switch between normal shooting and front-facing recording. Frame yourself more conveniently while creating vlogs, talking-head videos, travel updates and selfie-style content.

[2.0-INCH DISPLAY FOR EASY FRAMING & PLAYBACK]: The built-in 2.0-inch screen helps you clearly frame photos and videos, preview your shots and review captured content directly on the camera, making everyday shooting and vlogging more convenient.

[CREATIVE SHOOTING FROM MULTIPLE ANGLES]: The movable rotating design gives you greater flexibility to experiment with selfie shots, eye-level recording, low-angle shots and creative handheld perspectives for more interesting photos and videos.

[IDEAL FOR YOUTUBE, REELS & CONTENT CREATORS]: Whether you are starting a YouTube channel, recording Instagram reels, documenting trips or creating everyday lifestyle content, the Q10 combines essential photo and video capabilities in one creator-friendly camera.

[RECHARGEABLE BATTERY FOR EXTENDED SHOOTING]: Built-in rechargeable battery support allows you to capture photos, record videos and create content on the go without constantly depending on an external power source, making it convenient for travel, outings and everyday use.
